scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c red,white "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build -w client && npm run typecheck:vercel
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test
